description: This file contains JavaScript functions and initializations for form handling, including video URL parsing, image uploads, markdown and rich text editors, drag-and-drop file uploads, geolocation, and form auto-save features within a web application.

methods.name: parseVideoURL
methods.description: Parses a video URL to identify its type (YouTube, Vimeo, PeerTube), and constructs embed URLs, thumbnail URLs, and API URLs accordingly.

methods.name: _uploadImage
methods.description: Uploads image files via AJAX, providing progress updates and success/error callbacks.

methods.name: _createMarkdownEditor
methods.description: Initializes a Markdown editor with toolbar options, supports drag-and-drop image upload, and stores the editor instance.

methods.name: _createHtmlEditor
methods.description: Initializes a rich text (Summernote) editor with image upload callbacks and stores the editor instance.
